name: PostHog CI Metrics
description: Track workflow duration, success rates, and CI performance in PostHog

posthog-token.description: Your PostHog API token - see project settings section "Project API Key"

event.description: The event name to capture e.g. "GitHubActionCompleted". Optional when only creating an annotation.

properties.description: Properties to add to the event - as a JSON string. Must be possible to `JSON.parse(properties)`

capture-run-duration.description: Capture run duration via GitHub API (adds duration_seconds and run metadata)

capture-job-durations.description: Capture timing and status for each job in the workflow (emits one event per job)

github-token.description: GitHub token for API access (required for capture-run-duration, capture-job-durations, and status-job)

runner.description: Optional runner label to include in properties (e.g., 'depot')

status-job.description: Job name to check for workflow status (e.g., 'Django Tests Pass'). Captures that job's conclusion.

annotation.description: Create a PostHog annotation with this text (e.g., 'Deployed to production'). Can be used standalone or alongside event capture.

annotation-token.description: API key for the annotations REST API — a personal API key with the annotation:write scope. Defaults to posthog-token. Set this explicitly when capturing an even

annotation-hidden.description: If 'true', hide the annotation from the PostHog UI (charts and the annotations list) while keeping it readable via the API and MCP. Use for high-frequency marke

annotation-api-host.description: Host for the PostHog app API used to create annotations. This is the app host (e.g. https://us.posthog.com), NOT the event ingestion host in posthog-api-host.

annotation-project-id.description: Project to create the annotation in. Defaults to '@current' (the project the token belongs to).

annotation-dedupe.description: If 'true', skip creating the annotation when a matching one already exists (idempotent re-runs). Match is by annotation-dedupe-key, or the full annotation text

annotation-dedupe-key.description: Content prefix used to detect an existing annotation when annotation-dedupe is true. Defaults to the full annotation text. Use a stable prefix (e.g. 'Deployed r
